# Spike_Timing_Dependent_Attention

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An attention mechanism in spiking transformers that weights inputs based on the precise timing of spikes rather than scalar values. Leverages temporal precision inherent to neuromorphic computing, enabling more biologically plausible and efficient attention computation.
